name: TIER IV,Inc.
summary: Tier IV, Inc. develops open-source software for autonomous driving, including Autoware, software for urban driverless cars that handles lane detection, planning and following paths, detecting objects and 3D localization. It also offers a self-driving development kit, sensor fusion technologies and products such as laser scanners and cameras, mobility services, and the deployment, integration, testing, maintenance and operational support of autonomous driving systems. Incorporated in 2015, it has its base in Tokyo, Japan.
